description.value: Wasabi Modern Kitchen is a Japanese fine dining restaurant in Kamloops's Sun Rivers community, beside Big Horn Golf Course, led by a chef with over 21 years of experience across more than 10 Japanese restaurants. The menu blends traditional Japanese staples with modern Pacific Northwest influences, spanning a chef-driven sushi program, ramen, miso cod, kabayaki, and premium seafood. The 55-seat licensed space features a dedicated sushi bar and full drink bar in warm, modern surroundings.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Wasabi Modern Kitchen is a real, operating Japanese fine dining restaurant at 102-1020 Talasa Way in Kamloops's Sun Rivers community, matching the OSM address (minor postcode transposition on the website: 'V2H 03C' vs OSM's 'V2H 0C3'). The website contains no mention of bike parking, water refill, takeout, or any cycling-specific amenities, so those fields default to null. The website's copyright year of 2026 and OSM check_date of 2025-12-31 both support the business being currently open.
